Front: Entropy H(P) = −Σ P(x)·log P(x) đo {{c1::độ bất định (surprise)}} của phân phối P. H=0 khi {{c2::deterministic}}, H=max = {{c3::log₂K}} khi uniform qua K lớp. Đơn vị: bits (log₂), nats (logₑ).
Back: Entropy = average surprise. H(P) = −∑P·logP. H=0 khi P(1)=1; H=max cho uniform. Scipy: entropy(p, base=2). Bernoulli p=0.5: H=1 bit. Dùng entropy cơ sở ┐− info theory foundation cho loss functions.

Cross-entropy CE(P,Q) = {{c1::−Σ P·log Q}}. = H(P) + {{c2::KL(P||Q)}}. Minimize CE → {{c3::Q tiệm cận P}} (= minimize KL vì H(P) cố định). Dùng làm loss function cho classification, LLM.
Back: CE = expected −log prob của model Q under true P. Nếu Q=P ⇒ CE=H(P). Nếu Q≠P ⇒ CE>H(P) → loss >0. Training minimize CE = MLE for categorical distributions.

Front: BCE loss cho binary: = −[y·log(p)+(1−y)·log(1−p)] là CE của {{c1::Bernoulli distribution}}. MSE cho LinReg là CE của {{c2::Gaussian distribution}}. LLM loss = CE của {{c3::Categorical qua vocab 50K tokens}}.
Back: CE unifies all common ML losses. MLE with Bernoulli=BCE; MLE Gaussian=MSE; MLE Categorical=CE multi-class; LLM next token→Categorical CE per step. torch: F.cross_entropy(logits,target_id) bao softmax.

Front: KL divergence D(P||Q) = Σ P·log(P/Q). KL ≥ {{c1::0}} (Gibbs), =0 iff {{c2::P=Q}}. KL {{c3::asymmetric}} (D(P||Q)≠D(Q||P)). Scipy: entropy(p,q,base=2) tính KL.
Back: KL = CE − H(P). Asymmetric mét differentiate Forward ↕ mode-seeking, Reverse ↕ mean-seeking. Forward = training via CE. Reverse = VAE regularization via Gaussian prior. Code: entropy from scipy tính KL.

Front: Forward KL D(P||Q) = {{c1::mode-seeking}}— Q must capture mode of P. Dùng {{c2::MLE (CE training)}}. Reverse KL D(Q||P)= {{c3::mean-seeking}}— Q spread cover P, penalize excess. Dùng {{c4::VAE regularize encoder proximity prior.}}
Back: KL direction behavior: Forward chốt ensure khi P high ∧ Q low → penalty large land focus mode. Reverse penalize khi Q high ∧ P low → Q avoid where P zero. VAE encoder avoid over-confidence via reverse KL into N(0,I) prior.

JS divergence symmetric solution: JSD = {{c1::½[D(P||M)+D(Q||M)]}} với M = {{c2::(P+Q)/2}}. JS bounded: {{c3::0 ≤ JS ≤ ln2}}. √JS là metric. Dùng {{c4::GAN loss gốc.}}
Back: JSD symmetric: unlike KL, JSD bounded+ symmetric → easier to use for comparing distributions. GAN minimax à fight JSD via adversary. Code: def jsd(p,q): m=0.5*(p+q); return 0.5*(KL(p,m)+KL(q,m))

Front: Mutual Information I(X;Y) = Σ P(x,y)·log(P(x,y)/[P(x)·P(y)]) = {{c1::KL(P(XY)||P⊗Q)}}. I=0 iff {{c2::independent}}. Dùng sklearn: {{c3::mutual_info_classif}} feature selection. Correlation chỉ linear, MI đo {{c4::all nonlinear relationship}}.
Back: MI = entropy reduction: I(X;Y)=H(X)−H(X|Y). MI captures nonlinear relationship while Pearson limited. sklearn function for feature selection. Information bottleneck principle extract compressed Z that retains MI with Y.

Front: Perplexity PPL = {{c1::2^{CE}}} = exp(− (1/T)·Σ log P(wₜ|w<ₜ)) đo weighted inverse probability. PPL thấp → tốt; uniform random qua K → PPL≈{{c2::K}}. Modern LLM PPL {{c3::5−20}} trên eval. Code: torch.exp(loss).item()
Back: PPL = measurement cơ connection token prediction quality of language model. Lower=model better. Geometric average of 1/p per token. HF pipeline output loss directly→ torch.exp(loss)=PPL. Train evaluation monitor decrement.

Front: Log(0) khi tính CE → {{c1::ε 1e-8 added}}. Softmax overconfident → {{c2::label smoothing}} add epsilon 0.1 vào target để regularize. Scipy entropy function handle zeros automatically.
Back: Numerical pitfalls: never compute log of 0 via epsilon (1e-8) floor. label smoothing common in modern LLM training help prevent overconfident softmax for rare token classes. It converts one-hot target mixed flat into distributed target.

Front: Entropy H(P) fixed during CE minimization; therefore {{c1::gradient of CE = gradient of KL}}. Gradient ∂CE/∂Q that change model param without touching H(P). Tạo công thức ∂(CE)/∂logits = {{c2::softmax−onehot}}.
Back: key property: whiten CE minimize, H(P) constant not depend on model parameters. ∇ CE = ∇ KL via decomposition CE=H+KL. The convenient formula dCE/dlogits = softmax−onehot accelerates backprop for classification (torch.F.cross_entropy internally).
